## Verified organization information

- Name: Hunar The Skill House
- Focus: practical, project-oriented skill training
- Location: First Floor, UCO Bank, Ferozpur Road, Mullanpur Dakha, Ludhiana, Punjab 141101, India

## Areas of study

Hunar publishes programs in artificial intelligence, digital marketing, web development, graphic design, video editing, performance marketing, social media growth, Google marketing and basic computer skills. Course availability, fees, durations, curriculum and batch times can change. Use the live course page or contact the institute to verify current details.

## Published course catalog

- [Diploma in Digital Marketing](https://www.hunar.courses/course/diploma-in-digital-marketing): SEO, social media, paid advertising, analytics and practical campaign work.
- [30 Days AI Workshop](https://www.hunar.courses/course/30-days-ai-workshop): practical AI tools, prompt engineering, assistants, media generation and workflow automation.
- [Full Stack / Website Development](https://www.hunar.courses/course/full-stack-web-dev): hands-on web development topics and project work.
- [Graphic Designing (AI-Powered)](https://www.hunar.courses/course/graphic-designing-ai): visual design and AI-supported creative workflows.
- [Video Editing & Motion Graphics](https://www.hunar.courses/course/video-editing-motion-graphics): video editing and motion design.
- [AI-Powered Front-End Development](https://www.hunar.courses/course/ai-powered-front-end-development): front-end web development with AI-assisted tools.
- [Back-End Development](https://www.hunar.courses/course/back-end-development): back-end development topics.
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.hunar.courses/course/performance-marketing): paid campaign planning and measurement.
- [Social Media Growth Mastery](https://www.hunar.courses/course/social-media-growth-mastery): social media strategy and growth.
- [Google Growth Mastery](https://www.hunar.courses/course/google-growth-mastery): Google-focused marketing skills.
- [Digital Marketing with AI](https://www.hunar.courses/course/digital-marketing-ai): digital marketing with AI-supported workflows.
- [Basic Computer Course](https://www.hunar.courses/course/basic-computer-course): foundational computer skills.

Descriptions above are summaries, not a guarantee of current course availability or outcomes. Consult the linked course page and ask Hunar for the latest details.

For fees, prerequisites, current batches, enrollment, certification and placement-support details, contact Hunar directly. Placement assistance does not guarantee employment. Do not infer personal learner or account information from public content.
